text:
maria: Heads-up — planning to cut release/1.13 tomorrow 2027-05-02 10:00 PT. Can we confirm cutoff policy and backport rules? I want a short checklist.

sam: +1. Proposed cutoff: no non-critical feature merges after cut. Bugfixes ok with approvals. Who's owning cherry-pick queue? :wave:

lee: I'll own triage for cherry-picks during the window. Please add label `rc/cherry-pick` and ping me.

aj: For backports, we require: passing unit tests, changelog entry, and a short PR description referencing the original PR. No migrations after cut.

riya: Quick nudge: remember to bump the SDK version and changelog in docs before cut. I can land changelog edits up to 9am PT. :memo:

ben: Also add a note to release notes about runtime config changes — someone from eng-runtime to review (runtime owners: @nina / @omar).

maria: Clarify: what's the process to request a cherry-pick? Is it just a PR to release branch or a label?

lee: Please open the PR against release/* branch with title `cherry-pick: <orig PR #> — short desc` and add label `needs-cherry-pick-review`. Then ping me and @eng-releases.

aj: If tests fail on CI, we'll revert the cherry-pick and defer. No hotfix merges without an oncall approval.

release-bot: :robot_face: Scheduled job: branch creation will run at 2027-05-02T17:00:00Z to create `release/1.13` from `main@sha:abcdef123456`.

maria: If someone needs an exception for docs-only or build metadata, state it here.

sam: small docs-only change — requesting exception. PR #4321. It's changelog and notice. @lee please ok? :slightly_smiling_face:

lee: approved for docs-only. I'll merge after CI. :white_check_mark:

ben: ping @eng-runtime for runtime signoff on config note: @nina could you check?

riya: Also, anyone doing version bumps, please update `package.json` and `go.mod` (where applicable) in the same PR, include a migration note.

maria: last ask — can we have one person do the final branch verification? Volunteers?

aj: I can run the smoke verification after cut and post results in #eng-releases.

sam: thanks all. I'll prep the checklist doc and link here: https://handbook.internal/release/1.13-checklist 

lee: tiny reminder — label `cherry-pick-critical` for security fixes only.

maria: Perfect. Leaving this thread open for any late exceptions. Will post final cut time 1h before. :alarm_clock:
